description: The file defines the Paginated class which manages pagination logic for iterating over a record set, including page calculation, navigation, and layout handling.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: A class that manages pagination of a result set, providing methods to calculate pages, navigate, and generate navigation links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the pagination with a result set, page size, and page number.

methods.name: fetchNumberPages
methods.description: Calculates total number of pages based on the result set and page size.

methods.name: assignPageNumber
methods.description: Sets the current page number, defaulting to 1 if input is invalid.

methods.name: fetchPagedRow
methods.description: Fetches the next row in the current page.

methods.name: isFirstPage
methods.description: Checks if the current page is the first page.

methods.name: isLastPage
methods.description: Checks if the current page is the last page.
